quotes.context: Coach Brown draws on his experience with the Golden State Warriors to explain how the team must collectively compensate for roster changes.

When we won in 22, nobody did anything extra special. We had a young player and Jordan Poole step up. We had Andrew Wiggins probably have his best year since being drafted, come in and step up. quotes.context: Khris Middleton describes his leadership style and how he mentors younger players on the Washington Wizards.
quotes.quote: I think it is just being myself. I think the guys know behind closed doors a lot with the workouts and practices I talk a lot of junk. Just just competitive. I want to win whether it is a shooting game, basketball game, one on one game, anything. So they know I am competitive, they know I want to beat them, but they know I am on their same side too. So there is times where I might say, hey, try this instead of doing what you did, but it is all about motivating. It is all about helping.
